entries.speaker: adam
entries.text: A password is your secret code. It tells the computer it's really YOU. Keep it secret - even from your best friend. Long passwords are stronger than short ones. Mix big letters, small letters, numbers and symbols.
lines: A password is your secret code.
It tells the computer it's really YOU.
Keep it secret - even from your best friend.
Long passwords are stronger than short ones.
Mix big letters, small letters, numbers and symbols.

entries.speaker: layla
entries.text: Imagine ONE key opens your house AND your bike. If a thief steals it, they open both! Passwords are the same. Use a DIFFERENT one for every account. If one gets stolen, the others stay safe.
lines: Imagine ONE key opens your house AND your bike.
If a thief steals it, they open both!
Passwords are the same.
Use a DIFFERENT one for every account.
If one gets stolen, the others stay safe.

entries.speaker: adam
entries.text: Time to remember the five Golden Rules! One - keep it SECRET. Never share it. Two - make it LONG. Eight characters or more. Three - MIX letters, numbers and symbols. Four - make it UNIQUE for every account. Five - never use your name, birthday or the word 'password'.
lines: Time to remember the five Golden Rules!
One - keep it SECRET. Never share it.
Two - make it LONG. Eight characters or more.
Three - MIX letters, numbers and symbols.
Four - make it UNIQUE for every account.
Five - never use your name, birthday or the word 'password'.

entries.speaker: layla
entries.text: Phishing sounds like 'fishing' - and it works the same way. A hacker drops bait. Hoping you bite. Free prize? Bait. 'URGENT - type your password!' Bait. Message from someone you don't know? Be careful. If you're not sure, show a parent.
lines: Phishing sounds like 'fishing' - and it works the same way.
A hacker drops bait. Hoping you bite.
Free prize? Bait.
'URGENT - type your password!' Bait.
Message from someone you don't know? Be careful.
If you're not sure, show a parent.

entries.speaker: layla
entries.text: Wow! Look at everything you learned this week. Strong passwords - long and mixed. Secret passwords - even from your best friend. Unique passwords - one for every account. And you can spot phishing tricks too. Time to claim your stickers!
